saveHashScope: All files recursively under SaveManager's saves directory; Unity Editor Analytics is outside the player save directory.
saveIsolation: Direct Farm bootstrap; SaveInput disabled in memory before Play Mode. No save/load calls. Scene reopened without saving on exit.
limitations: Static camera views at current gameplay aspect. Teleports are framing only; do not prove movement, collision traversal, animation fluidity or human acceptance. Bounds include sprite geometry, not alpha-only silhouette. Screen Space Overlay UI is not rendered by Camera.Render.

physicalRoutes.reason: All approaches connected; dock water blocked; every sampled natural boundary segment blocks outward player-collider sweeps.
physicalRoutes.method: Cardinal BFS at 0.5 world units; actual player collider OverlapCollider and Cast with Physics2D layer collision mask; each route starts at captured spawn. No movement input, interaction or animation is simulated.

motion.timing: Every PNG carries its observed Time.time and fixedTime; preview timing must use consecutive timestamp deltas, never an invented constant playback rate. Moving-body snapshots target 0.09s intervals; stationary duplicates are omitted. Door poses are captured when observed to change.
motion.method: Initial framing at the earlier physically validated house selection position. Thereafter actual player Rigidbody2D.MovePosition in FixedUpdate, with PlayerController temporarily disabled. Live selector invokes only HouseDoorInteractable. No forced alpha/door state, injected input, portal, save or load. Water reads actual Tilemap.GetAnimationFrame. This is controlled-body traversal, not a movement-input test.
checks: Closed door stopped the real driven player body.
Opening exposed intermediate frames; blocker released only at final clear pose.
Live close interaction was refused with the player body occupying the doorway.
Actual feet entry revealed configured interior without forcing alpha.
Actual feet exit restored the exterior and hid the interior.
Closing exposed at least three distinct poses; blocker returned only at the final closed frame.
Closed-again door stopped a second controlled traversal attempt.
Water.GetAnimationFrame changed across at least four poses during >=1.4s with identical lake/river colliders.
